name: long-word
note: css-text-3 §6.2: a long unbreakable word at the default overflow-wrap:normal overflows its line without splitting (one overflowing line plus the following word on the next); overflow-wrap:break-word moves the word to its own line and splits it there (the following word lands after the split chunks); word-break:break-all fills every line with the word's characters. The word-wrap legacy alias computes the same value.
